description.en: OmniTraffic is a controllable generation pipeline and benchmark for spatio-temporal traffic reasoning. It provides 8M VQA samples and a 3K human-verified test set across 12 reconstructed 3D intersections, with a three-level task hierarchy covering scene perception, multi-view and temporal reasoning, and decision support.

claire_radar.whyItMatters: OmniTraffic fills the gap in evaluating structure-aware traffic reasoning under controlled conditions, where existing traffic benchmarks focus on passive recognition. The extensible pipeline allows configurable scenarios for reproducible evaluation and simulation-generated supervision for model fine-tuning.
